title: decision: refuse to join a group whose tree has a leaf missing a required component
description: mls-extensions #110 rule 3: a LeafNode in a group is invalid if the GroupContext app_components or safe_aad lists a component its list does not (part of RFC 9420 §7.3 leaf validation). Mark 2026-11-02: join_welcome, join_external and Observer::from_group_info refuse such a tree. Supersedes decision mimid-1wgh.4.57 (report, not refuse). Proposal/UpdatePath leaves are checked against the pre-Commit GroupContext, superseding mimid-1wgh.4.49 for those leaves (K4).
